'''AdmiralThrawn36 Court Evo-lution no flip''' is a [[Dark]] constructed list published on [[Game Players Network]].

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[AdmiralThrawn36]]
* '''Published:''' 22 July 2003 (Game Players Network)
* '''GPN category:''' Standard
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS3]]
* '''Side:''' [[Dark]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Court Of The Vile Gangster / Vile Gangsters|EJP-D-courtofthevilegangster.gif|label=Court Of The Vile Gangster}}
* '''Strategy:''' Court Of The Vile Gangster
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:POVS3 Vile AdmiralThrawn36 DS 2003 CourtEvo.txt |Download]]

== Introduction ==

This deck in play testing has been successful, beating Cam’s MWYHL deck, losing only 6 force (sorry to have to refer to this loss Cam). Please rate accordingly…

== Strategy ==

I’m not going to give a long strategy. I will tell you that I used this deck to beat a 4 saber deck. Anyways the basic strategy is to control as much of Tatooine as possible. Then pull Tat Occ. As fast as possible while draining. I’ve found while playtesting (when I forgot about gailid) that I could easily force my opponent to lose 6-7 force per turn via force drains. I wish I had location, location, location but I seem to be fine right now since the deck does not rely on a specific location (the closest to this would be tatooine, but this strategy is not essential). Even while getting Tatooine quite late, I was able to do some hefty damage quite easily. Hope you enjoy and give me a few suggestions and a good rating ;) (j/k)\
